name: Freshwater Pearl Drop Necklace
description: A delicate gold-tone cable chain necklace suspending a single lustrous freshwater pearl drop pendant.
materials: Fine gold-vermeil-look cable chain, genuine-look freshwater pearl drop
primaryColors: Warm gold with soft ivory pearl
negativeConstraints: Never render a second pearl, charm, gemstone, tag, or any text/engraving anywhere on the chain or clasp; never let the chain read as thick or chunky, it must stay fine and delicate at every angle.
preservationNotes: Keep the pearl's teardrop shape, size, and soft ivory sheen identical across every angle; keep the clasp hardware plain, blank, unmarked metal in every shot, no tag or stamping.
